column3: “the skillfully woven band” renders “hesheb,” the band.
“the holy crown” renders “the crown (nezer) of holiness.”
“caps” renders “headdresses,” and “ordain” renders “fill the hand of.”
“a soothing aroma” renders “an odor of soothing,” and “an offering by fire” renders “isheh,” a fire offering.
NASB supplies “the rest of” before “the blood.”
“the heave offering” renders “the contribution (terumah)” (also in verse 28), and “offered” renders “raised.”
“their portion forever” renders “a prescribed portion of perpetuity.”
